ValidationRule.description: The Billing Street, City, State, Postal Code, and Country are required fields.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Opportunity_at_Proposal_Stage__c = TRUE, OR( ISBLANK(BillingStreet), ISBLANK(BillingCity), ISBLANK(BillingState), ISBLANK(BillingPostalCode), ISBLANK(BillingCountry) ), NOT( OR( ISCHANGED(Opportunity_Open__c), ISCHANGED(Opportunities__c), ISCHANGED(Opportunity_Closed_Lost__c), ISCHANGED(Opportunity_Closed_Won__c), ISCHANGED(Opportunity_Total__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Billing Street, City, State, Postal Code, and Country are required fields on the Account when a related Opportunity reaches Proposal Stage.
